messages.content: "請問您能告訴我使用ARIMA模型的蘋果公司未來30天的股價預測，並提供使用LSTM模型的微軟未來45天的股票預測嗎？之後，您能提供紐約市未來7天的天氣預報，然後再給出洛杉磯未來14天的天氣預報嗎？"

message.reasoning:
The user wants two stock forecasts: Apple (AAPL) using ARIMA for next 30 days; Microsoft (MSFT) using LSTM for next 45 days. Then weather forecast for New York City for next 7 days; then Los Angeles for next 14 days.

We need to call the functions accordingly. We have two function calls: one for stock_forecast with company "Apple", days=30, model default ARIMA. Another for stock_forecast with company "Microsoft", days=45, model="LSTM". Then we need to call weather_forecast twice: first location "New York City", days=7; second location "Los Angeles", days=14.

We should do them sequentially. According to guidelines, we can only return one function call at a time. So we will call the first function: stock_forecast for Apple. Then after receiving result, we call next function: stock_forecast for Microsoft. Then after that, call weather_forecast for NYC. Then call weather_forecast for LA.

But the user asked all four predictions in one request. We can handle it by calling each function sequentially. We'll start with the first function call: stock_forecast for Apple.
